newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar to regulate its financial investment sector.
newsitem.headline: Qatar to regulate its financial investment sector.

text.p: Qatar Central Bank on Monday said a law regulating activities of investment companies in the Gulf state would be issued within weeks.
"We are outlining regulations for investment firms and will be issuing them within weeks," said Abdullah bin Khaled al-Attiyah, governor of Qatar Central Bank.

Another official said the new regulations, intended to bolster the state's growing financial markets, would shift the regulatory authority over locally-incorporated investment companies from the Ministry of Finance, Economy and Trade to the Central Bank.
He said the new law would set a minimum capital requirement for locally-registered investment firms, which invest mainly on international markets. The official gave no details.
Under the present system, investment firms register with the Ministry of Finance, Economy and Trade and are not required to maintain a minimum capital.
